proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 851 article gives Malayalam er̤uka to rise, be high; er̤u height, prominence; er̤uma rising; er̤umpuka = er̤uka; eṭukka to raise, lift, take up, build, undertake, choose; become raised, visible, prominent; eṭuppu raising, taking up, harvest; eṭuppikka to get to take up, get built;…. The Malayalam survey form eḍut̪t̪u “take” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
